title: 地产拖累经济：政策还在等，需求何时修复？
speaker: Wang Shengzhu

segments.en: I think China's economic data in July has been below expectation across the board.
segments.zh: 我认为7月份的经济数据全面低于预期。

segments.en: But to me, this is more structural rather than cyclical, because we see the largest drag is still the housing market.
segments.zh: 但在我看来，这更多是结构性问题而非周期性问题，因为最大的拖累仍是地产市场。

segments.en: And we see that the new house starts and house sales are still in a deeper recession.
segments.zh: 我们看到新屋开工和住宅成交仍处于较深的调整中。

segments.en: And also, including, for example, consumer demand, vehicle sales. Vehicle and housing are the two largest single expenditure items for any household, similar even in the US.
segments.zh: 同时，消费需求、汽车销售也偏弱。汽车和住房是家庭最大的两项支出，美国也是如此。

segments.en: So this is reflect some weak consumer demand, but to me it's more on the over-investment in the housing market in the previous years, and also the housing market itself is developing and also resulting in a weak consumer demand.
segments.zh: 这反映了消费需求偏弱，但更多是前些年地产市场过度建设所致，地产市场自身调整也拖累了消费需求。

segments.en: And on the other side, that's some over-capacity, over-supply issue, causing the deflation has been lasting so long.
segments.zh: 另一方面，存在产能过剩和供给过剩问题，导致价格下行持续较久。

segments.en: So to me, the policy makers, they are in a relatively wait-and-see or muddling-through mode.
segments.zh: 所以在我看来，政策制定者处于相对观望或边走边看的状态。

segments.en: As long as the growth, like Yvonne mentioned, as long as the growth can maintain at the lower end for this year, say, 4.5%.
segments.zh: 只要增长能维持在今年目标区间的下限，比如4.5%左右。

segments.en: They don't want a very drastic stimulus package, given that they also acknowledge it's more structural issue, and rather than cyclical components of it.
segments.zh: 他们不希望推出过于激进的刺激方案，因为他们也认识到这更多是结构性问题，而非周期性问题。
